parameters.name: AcceleratorType
parameters.description: The accelerator type used to filter the results. Valid values: `CPU` and `GPU`.

parameters.name: GPUType
parameters.description: The GPU type used to filter the results. Fuzzy matching is supported.

parameters.name: NodeTypes
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of node types. If omitted, all node types are returned.

parameters.name: QuotaId
parameters.description: The quota ID. You must specify either this parameter or `ResourceGroupIds`.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupIds
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of resource group IDs. You must specify either this parameter or `QuotaId`. The `UserId` for the specified `ResourceGroupId` must match the `UserId` of the requesting user. All specified `resource group` instances must be of the same type and associated with the same Virtual Private Cloud (VPC).
